result.summary: The page is generally well aligned, but the promotional banner has a significant text-contrast problem.

issues.description: The white headline and offer details on the pale mint promotional banner have very low contrast, making the promotion, checkout code, and minimum-order requirement difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark green text on the mint background, or substantially darken the background. Ensure contrast ratios of at least 4.5:1 for regular text and 3:1 for large text.
